# Switching Bluefield-2 from DPU to NIC {#switching-bf2-nic-dpu}

You can switch the Bluefield-2 network device from data processing unit (DPU) mode to network interface controller (NIC) mode.

Before you perform any tasks in the following documentation, ensure that you [installed the SR-IOV Network Operator](/openshift-docs-markdown/networking/networking_operators/sr-iov-operator/installing-sriov-operator#installing-sriov-operator).

**Additional resources**

- [Installing SR-IOV Network Operator](/openshift-docs-markdown/networking/networking_operators/sr-iov-operator/installing-sriov-operator#installing-sriov-operator)
